title: Secret handling
problem: New secrets can enter source, reports or transcripts.
rationale: Fast/merge gate; newly introduced secrets never enter a baseline. No auto-rotation/credential write.
applicability: Candidate diff and new source files; optional approved full-tree baseline scan.
baseline_policy: No newly introduced secrets may be grandfathered.

target_check.deterministic: Gitleaks on candidate diff/new files, optional full-tree baseline scan; redact stdout/reports before persistence.
target_check.reviewer: secret use and data flow. Scan clean does not prove absence of all secrets; no matched value in a transcript.
target_check.limits: **D:** Gitleaks on candidate diff/new files, optional full-tree baseline scan; redact stdout/reports before persistence. **R:** secret use and data flow. Scan clean does not prove absence of all secrets; no matched value in a transcript.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Fast/merge gate; newly introduced secrets never enter a baseline. No auto-rotation/credential write.

expected_evidence: **D:** Gitleaks on candidate diff/new files, optional full-tree baseline scan; redact stdout/reports before persistence. **R:** secret use and data flow. Scan clean does not prove absence of all secrets; no matched value in a transcript.
repair: Remove the newly introduced secret from the candidate and redact reports; request human credential rotation if exposure occurred, then rerun scanning. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.
